label: Rejected the initial unqualified draft Supply/Escape equivalence
summary: Rejected the initial unqualified draft Supply/Escape equivalence. LocalPower only selects some active alternative; it does not make all admitted alternatives of the active target have active contributors. A failed proof exposed this gap before any certification. The revised claim explicitly retains PoweredGroups for supplier records, and AdmissionOmission certifies failure without it: active self-support plus an admitted inactive external alternative satisfies LocalPower and Escape yet has no Supply. Arbitrary admission must not be silently promoted to exercised active power. The original all-member draft was also rejected: enabling occurrence is not productive power. The final contributor-only semantics and EnablerControl preserve that distinction. No Challenge was accepted or result claimed for either rejected draft; the corrected claim was frozen before completing its corrected proof.
